messages:
maria: saw a spike of 415s on inference-api around 09:12; looks concentrated to a handful of tenants.

jon: any UA or SDK version commonalities?

maria: UA shows `redwood-sdk/1.1.3` and some raw HTTP clients. Content-Type is plain `application/json`.

lee: That's the v2 content-type enforcement kicking in (`application/json+rw-v2`). We rolled that predicate in yesterday. We expected some stragglers but not this steady.

eva: Did the planned compatibility gate (edge translator) go out? I thought we left it on for a graceful window.

maria: I checked — the feature flag is set to false in prod by default. Canary in one region had it on but not the wider roll. deploy-bot: feature-flag compat.v2.auto-translate set=true for cluster-eu at 09:15

jon: Immediate mitigation proposal: enable an edge-layer auto-wrapping translator that will accept `application/json` and, when payload shape looks like old v1 (string or top-level text field), wrap it into the v2 envelope. Tag translated requests and limit timeframe per-tenant.

lee: Agree. Implementation constraints: 1) must be idempotent for already-v2 requests, 2) avoid accidentally changing array semantics, 3) telemetry per-tenant and per-cluster.

maria: Proposed heuristic code: ```if content_type == 'application/json': try: parsed = json.loads(body) except: parsed = body if isinstance(parsed, str) or 'text' in parsed or 'input' in parsed: body = {'input': parsed} content_type = 'application/json+rw-v2' add_header('x-compat-wrapped','true') emit_metric('compat.wrap', tags={'tenant':tenant_id})```

jon: Add opt-in state: auto-wrap enabled only for tenants with >0 415s in last 24h and capped to first 7 days of roll for that tenant. After that, auto-wrap must be manually enabled or tenant upgrades.

lee: Instead of hard cutoff, suggest notification + scheduled shutdown: send tenant owners a migration notice on day 1, day 3, and day 6; disable auto-wrap on day 8 if not opted in. That balances runway and pressure.

eva: Also: produce an aggregation dashboard: per-tenant translated count, error reduction, and sample payloads (redacted) so PMs/support can help customers.

maria: Tests: unit tests for wrapping logic, e2e hitting lb with `redwood-sdk/1.1.3`, and a regression test ensuring arrays are not wrapped.

jon: Ops rollout plan: 1) hotpatch edge lambda with translator + metrics (30m) 2) enable for affected clusters one at a time (5m each) 3) watch `http_415.rate`, `compat.wrap.count`, and support channels for 2h 4) run tenant notification job.

lee: Security note: ensure we don't lift any stricter parsing that could hide malformed JSON; keep strict schema checks after wrapping.

eva: I'll draft the tenant notification text and the dashboard layout. maria, can you own the lambda change and the feature-flag toggle?

maria: On it. Opening PR now titled "edge: v1->v2 auto-wrap shim (hotfix)".

deploy-bot: PR #5012 merged to main at 09:48, feature-default=false in prod.

maria: Enabled feature-flag on cluster-us-west for impacted tenants. Monitoring now.

jon: Longer-term: build a dedicated compatibility service (stateful) that can be queried by edge and has explicit tenancy, opt-ins, and audit logs. Edge shim should be temporary. Put RFC on backlog.

lee: +1. Add list of follow-ups in the PR: RFC for compat-service, opt-in APIs for tenants, expanded telemetry, and a runbook for shutting auto-wrap off.

maria: Summarizing: short-term edge auto-wrap with telemetry + tenant notices, 1-week tenant grace window, long-term compat-service RFC. Will post status update in #eng-infra after 2 hours. :white_check_mark:
